# Release 1.26 — Stance explain L3 (LLM prose bound to engine)

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.25 ships (may freeze after 1.23 if L2 deferred; see Dependencies)  
**Milestone:** `1.26`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub only.

---

## Outcome

Optional **plain-language explanation** of an existing Stance Engine result helps beginners understand Buy/Hold/Avoid. The LLM (or local model) **rewrites evidence only**. It **must not change `label`**, invent metrics, or add facts not present in the stance contract / cited stored fields.

If no model is configured, the feature is **off** and the UI keeps L1 template Simple view — app remains usable on strict free posture.

---

## Locked decisions

| Decision | Choice | Agent implication |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Label authority | Engine only | Prompt must include label+evidence; post-validate label unchanged |
| Cost | Prefer free/local model; else rare cheap API (B) | No required paid API to run the product |
| Failure mode | Fall back to template bullets | Never block detail page on LLM errors |
| Hallucination control | Cite only provided evidence; refuse new numbers | Server-side check: no numeric claims not in input |
| Storage | Optional cache of explanation text keyed by instrument + engine_version + model id | Private or ephemeral OK |
| SEBI | Out of scope | Still show research honesty copy |

### Prompt/IO contract (normative)

**Input to explainer:** full stance JSON (1.23/1.25) + optional portfolio overlay (1.24).  
**Output:** `{ explanation_markdown_or_text, cited_evidence_ids_or_bullets, model_id, prompt_version }`.  
**Validation:** parsed output must not include a different `label`; strip/reject if model returns a trade order.

## Foundation

- [ ] Explainer adapter interface behind StanceEngine (swap local vs API)  
- [ ] Feature flag / env: model endpoint optional

- [ ] Rate limit / single-flight per instrument to control cost  
- [ ] Logs without leaking API keys

## Out of scope

- Agentic multi-turn research (1.27)  
- Letting the model choose Buy/Hold/Avoid  
- Fine-tuning paid training pipelines  
- Voice UI  

---

## Exit

With a model configured, beginner Simple view can show LLM prose that matches engine evidence and label; without a model, app still shows L1 stance; guards prevent label mutation and fabricated figures in automated tests.

---

## Agent planning instructions

1. **Never** call the model before StanceEngine returns a label.  
2. Prefer stubbed tests over live API in CI (free posture).  
3. If cost pressure: ship stub + template only; document API as optional.  
4. Allowed to implement after 1.23 even if 1.25 deferred — then explain L1/L1+overlay only.  
5. One issue per checkbox; milestone `1.26`.
